# Table Column Style

An aligned table satisfies the aligned style.

| Name  | Value |
| ----- | ----- |
| Alice | 100   |

A tight table satisfies the tight style.

|Name|Value|
|---|---|
|Bob|200|

A table that matches no style is reported against the closest one.

| Name | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Carol | 300 |
|Dave|400|
